verdict.rationale: MX is a financial-data API platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question here. A probe found an official MCP server documented at docs.mx.com/mcp, which delivers the core of the story. The evidence is limited to that single probe hit, with no detail on what the server does. Missing for 10: details of the exposed tools and resources, authentication and setup instructions for connecting an agent, supported transports, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
